top_signals.title: Asian Stocks Set to Gain as Oil Extends Declines: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Asian stocks were set to advance as falling oil prices eased inflation concerns and pushed bond yields lower, while traders awaited Nvidia Corp.’s earnings for fresh clues on the outlook for artificial intelligence.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Ukraine needs changes to avoid losing war, ousted defense minister says
top_signals.summary: Fedorov, a young reformer whose dismissal last month sparked weeks of protests, said Ukraine lacked any overall vision for how to win the conflict.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
